title: H-ENTANGLEMENT-LOG-ASYMPTOTICS: Analytic Resolution of Latorre-Sierra Tension via Logarithmic Entanglement Scaling
author: Antigravity (ExactQuantumNumericsMind v1.0, eqn-mix)

H-ELA-1.statement: Bipartite Schmidt-von-Neumann entropy follows logarithmic scaling S_vN(N) = a * ln(N) + b with R^2 >= 0.990 across nq in [5, 14]

H-ELA-2.statement: Global effective power-law exponent alpha_eff is bounded by alpha_eff <= 0.35, fundamentally refuting Latorre-Sierra alpha -> 1
H-ELA-2.metric: alpha_eff = (ln S_14 - ln S_5) / (ln N_14 - ln N_5)

H-ELA-3.statement: Prime state exhibits structured sub-entropy relative to Poisson random subsets Delta S = S_rand - S_prime >= 0.10 across nq in [5, 10]
H-ELA-3.falsification_condition: Any nq in [6, 10] with Delta S < 0.05

methodology.bipartite_split: Balanced cut nA = floor(nq / 2), nB = nq - nA
methodology.solver: Full SVD on exact statevector tensor product representation
